blocks.text: Wheatstone bridge (Fig. 9.30) ek electric circuit hai jis mein chaar resistances R1, R2, R3 aur R4 is tarah jore jate hain ke jaal (mesh) ABCDA banta hai. Nuqton A aur C ke darmiyan battery, aur nuqton B aur D ke darmiyan resistance Rg ka hassas galvanometer jora jata hai. Switch S band karne par aam taur par galvanometer mein current behega. Hamein woh shart maloom karni hai jis par switch band hone ke baad bhi galvanometer mein current na behe.

blocks.alt: Wheatstone bridge: chaar resistors R1 (A se B), R2 (B se C), R3 (A se D), R4 (D se C) heera ABCD banate hain; galvanometer G (resistance Rg) B aur D ko jorta hai; neeche battery aur switch S, A aur C ko. Anticlockwise teer loop currents: ABDA mein I1, BCDB mein I2, battery wale loop mein I3.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.30: Wheatstone bridge circuit (kitab ki Figure 9.30 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jab B aur D ka potential barabar ho to galvanometer mein current nahi (I1 = I2) aur R1/R2 = R3/R4. Teen maloom resistances se chauthi na-maloom resistance nikal sakte hain.

Kitab circuit ka tajziya Kirchhoff ke doosre qaide se karti hai, do loops ABDA aur BCDB le kar, anticlockwise loop currents I1 aur I2 ke saath: loop ABDA se -I1 R1 - (I1 - I2) Rg - I1 R3 = 0 ... (9.46) aur loop BCDB se -I2 R2 - I2 R4 - (I2 - I1) Rg = 0 ... (9.47). Galvanometer mein current sifar hai agar I1 - I2 = 0, yaani I1 = I2, aur kitab equations ko balance ki shart R1/R2 = R3/R4 ... (9.51) tak le jati hai.

Yehi shart seedhe bhi dekhi ja sakti hai. Balance par galvanometer se koi current nahi guzarta, to nuqte B aur D ek hi potential par hain. Tab R1 aur R2 mein ek hi current behta hai, aur R3 aur R4 mein ek hi. A se B tak R1 par potential ki girawat A se D tak R3 par girawat ke barabar hai, aur B se C tak R2 par girawat D se C tak R4 par girawat ke barabar hai. Pehli barabari ko doosri se taqseem karne par R1/R2 = R3/R4.

blocks.title: Balanced Wheatstone bridge
blocks.text: Jab bhi R1/R2 = R3/R4 ... (9.51) poori ho, galvanometer mein koi current nahi behta aur woh koi jhukao (deflection) nahi dikhata; ulat, jab galvanometer koi jhukao na dikhaye to shart poori hai.

Agar teen maloom, badalne wali resistances R1, R2 aur R3 aur chauthi na-maloom resistance R4 jori jayein, aur R1, R2 aur R3 ko tab tak badla jaye jab tak galvanometer koi jhukao na dikhaye, to na-maloom resistance R4 maloom resistances se Eq. 9.51 ke zariye nikali ja sakti hai: R4 = R2 R3/R1.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Eq. 9.49' ka hawala deti hai, magar bridge ke balance ki shart R1/R2 = R3/R4 Eq. 9.51 hai, jis se R4 = R2 R3/R1 nikalta hai. Is liye sahi hawala Eq. 9.51 hai.

blocks.prompt: Wheatstone bridge kya hai? Diagram ki madad se wazeh kijiye (comprehensive question 9.3). Kuch electric aalaat mein teen pin wala plug kyun istemal hota hai (Point to ponder)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh chaar resistors ka jaal ABCDA hai jis mein A aur C ke darmiyan cell aur B aur D ke darmiyan galvanometer hai; jab R1/R2 = R3/R4 ho to B aur D ek potential par hote hain aur galvanometer koi jhukao nahi dikhata, to teen maloom resistances se na-maloom resistance nikalti hai. Teesra (earth) pin aale ke dhaati jism ko zameen se jorta hai: agar live taar jism ko chhu jaye to current is kam resistance wale raste se zameen mein chala jata hai, aam taur par fuse urta hai, us shakhs se guzarne ki bajaye jo use chhuye.

items: Wheatstone bridge: jaal ABCDA mein chaar resistors, AC par cell, BD par galvanometer. Balanced (galvanometer mein current nahi) jab R1/R2 = R3/R4 (9.51); tab B aur D ek potential par. Na-maloom R4 = R2 R3/R1.
